observations: Photo 0: Stainless-look gas cooker/range with glass splashback up, 4 round gas burner heads visible plus 2 flat black electric hotplates in the middle, standing against tiled wall.
Photo 1: Same cooker with 4 gas burners lit (blue flames visible), 2 electric hotplates visible but not glowing or powered in this shot, glass splashback reflecting tiles.

Photo 2: Front/oven view, taken outdoors or near window; control panel has multiple knobs, some knob positions look empty or inconsistent; oven door open, interior looks dusty/worn with a wooden stick propping it or a rack; no brand or model text visible anywhere in any photo.
No manufacturer name, logo, or model plate is legible in any of the three photos.

identity.kind: freestanding gas cooker with oven and 2 electric hotplates (6-burner combo range)

claims.claim: 4 gas burners and 2 (electric) burners making 6 burners in total
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show 4 round gas burner heads and 2 flat electric hotplates, matching the stated 4+2 configuration.

Photo 1 shows the 4 gas burners lit with blue flame, which supports the gas side working, but the 2 electric hotplates are not shown powered or glowing, and the oven's heating function is not demonstrated in any photo.

risks.risk: Electric hotplates may not heat despite gas burners working
risks.proof: A photo or short video of each electric plate glowing red/hot when switched on
risks.if_unproven: priced as electric hotplates not working

risks.risk: Oven may not reach or hold temperature, or igniter/heating element may be faulty
risks.proof: Video of oven interior heating up with a thermometer or visible glow

risks.risk: Control knobs appear missing or inconsistent on the front panel in Photo 2
risks.proof: Close-up photo of all control knobs and their fit on the shafts

risks.risk: Oven interior shows wear, dust, and a wooden stick possibly propping a broken rack or hinge
risks.proof: Clear close-up of oven door hinge and rack mechanism without obstruction
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a damaged or missing oven rack/hinge

risks.risk: Gas hose, regulator, and safety valve condition unknown, relevant to safe resale
risks.proof: Photo of the rear gas connection point and hose/regulator
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing new hose/regulator for safe use

proof_requests: Video showing all 4 gas burners lit simultaneously and the 2 electric hotplates glowing when switched on
Video of the oven heating up with visible flame or glowing element and a thermometer reading
Close-up photo of the control panel showing all knobs present and correctly fitted
Close-up photo of the rear gas connection, hose, and regulator
Clear photo of the oven door hinge and interior racks without any makeshift props
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a 4-gas-burner plus 2-electric-hotplate combo cooker with oven, so a worst-case price can be set; the 'all working perfectly' claim is only partly supported (gas burners lit) while the electric plates and oven function remain unverified and must be priced as non-functional until proven.
